description: "Mathieu Ropars: et cetera" by William Young is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story unfolds around Mathieu Ropars, the keeper of a lazaretto on an isolated island off the coast of France, as he navigates family life, friendships, and the shadow of disease that looms over their secluded existence.
